original_test_intent: Validate NVIDIA memory correctable-error handling at an approved memory target, including correct localization, reporting and continued operation without escalation or memory-capacity loss, once the missing procedure and Criteria are provided.
original_method: Keep injection blocked today. Future approved method must map DIMM/channel/rank/address, baseline memory and RAS counters, inject one correctable event with a pinned NV tool, correlate syndrome/address and fresh OS/firmware records, verify no reset or UCE escalation, then confirm capacity, page state and workload health.
manual_activity: The NVIDIA memory-RAS owner authors the missing CE procedure and acceptance matrix, maps the exact memory location, supervises the one-shot injection and confirms recovery and data integrity.
required_inputs: Pinned NVIDIA memory RAS tool/spec/version/checksum and supported platform/firmware/OS
Exact CE injection command and proof it cannot select UCE/poison unintentionally
Expected syndrome, source, severity, counter delta, timeout and no-reset/no-escalation rule
Memory scrub/page-offline policy, workload/data-integrity oracle and abort limits
OOB/console recovery, restoration and post-test topology/capacity criteria
safety_requirements: Do not inject while Procedure and Criteria remain TBD
Use an isolated recoverable SUT and disposable verified workload/data set with console/OOB access
Snapshot topology, counters, poison/page state and logs without erasing evidence
One mapped address/event once; no loops or retries; abort on UCE, reset, hang, capacity change or unexplained counter delta
Restore injector, poison/page state and confirm stable memory before verdict
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only memory topology, EDAC/RAS counters, logs and recovery readiness
Validate future supplied tool, mapping and evidence contract in a fresh review
Do not fabricate or run an injector, choose an address, clear counters/logs, offline pages, reset, recover, repeat or decide result
engineer_actions: Replace TBD with a target-specific CE procedure and Criteria
Approve tool, address decoder, count and non-escalation oracle
Restore memory state and issue verdict

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use one decoded memory location and prove a single bounded CE with matching syndrome/counter evidence, no reset/escalation, intact capacity and clean workload recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: The source has no method; this defines missing evidence categories without selecting a vendor command or address.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Baseline inventory and logs alone do not exercise memory CE handling and cannot count as execution.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong target or error type can poison live data, create an uncorrectable event, hang the host or permanently offline memory.

project_override_considerations: Platform-specific address translation and NVIDIA error semantics must be authoritative. A generic EDAC injection or neighboring UCE procedure does not preserve this testcase's coverage.
expected_evidence: Approved NV memory CE tool/spec and exact topology/address mapping
Baseline DIMM inventory, capacity, decoder, CE/UCE counters, page/poison state and logs
Exact one-shot CE command and synchronized target/timeline
Matching correctable syndrome/address/source and exactly bounded counter delta in fresh OS/firmware evidence
No reset, UCE escalation, persistent poison, page loss or capacity change; workload/data integrity recovered

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria both consistently state TBD. The source is incomplete, not contradictory.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Define Reliability row 102 Wistron-System RAS-00822-V003: provide the authoritative NVIDIA memory-CE tool/spec/version/checksum, supported platform/firmware/OS, exact DIMM/channel/rank/address or error-index mapping and command, expected correctable syndrome/source/counter delta/timeout with no reset or UCE escalation, scrub/page/poison and data-integrity rules, OOB recovery, aborts and restoration; require fresh review before execution.

review_improvement: Makes CE-specific localization, bounded counter delta, no-escalation and memory-capacity/data-integrity recovery mandatory while honoring the TBD blocker.
independent_technical_reasoning: Correctable memory handling is only demonstrated when the injected physical/logical target matches the reported syndrome and location and the event remains bounded. A generic log line could be stale or from another DIMM, while a wrong address translation can corrupt live data or escalate severity. The literal TBD fields therefore block execution, not static review.
